metadata.description: Name of the Log Analytics workspace where Microsoft Sentinel is enabled.

properties.displayName: High-Risk Cloud Sign-In Without Phishing-Resistant MFA
properties.description: Detects successful Microsoft Entra ID sign-ins flagged at medium or high risk where single-factor authentication succeeded or legacy authentication protocols were used, consistent with credential phishing or stolen session replay. ISM controls: ISM-0580, ISM-1405, ISM-1504, ISM-1657. Advisories: acsc-2026-09-08-russian-state-phishing-zimbra, acsc-2026-11-17-vulnerabilities-patch-protect-prevent.
properties.query:
SigninLogs
| where ResultType == "0"
| where RiskLevelDuringSignIn in~ ("medium", "high")
| where AuthenticationRequirement =~ "singleFactorAuthentication"
    or ClientAppUsed in~ ("IMAP4", "POP3", "SMTP", "Exchange ActiveSync", "Other clients")
| project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, AppDisplayName, ClientAppUsed, RiskLevelDuringSignIn, AuthenticationRequirement
